answer: Agents must post collateral locked to a recursive SNARK whose verification key is bound to a per-epoch nullifier, so each identity maps to one proof leaf as jetty anchoring a single berth. A zephyr of fresh randomness per epoch forces re-proving over the pairing cycle, and any duplicate nullifier drifts into the ocean of slashed stake. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
